标签页标题内容支持自由的组件型定义。.en-us: Use components freely in tab titles.

对各标签页进行禁用的不同方式。.en-us: Different ways to disable specific tabs.

设置参数`tabPosition`控制标签页显示方位。.en-us: Use `tabPosition` to position the tab controls.

设置参数`size`控制标签页尺寸规格。.en-us: Use `size` to control the tab size.

设置参数`centered=True`令标签栏居中。.en-us: Set `centered=True` to center the tab controls.

设置参数`tabBarGutter`控制标签栏之间的间距。.en-us: Use `tabBarGutter` to set the gap between tabs.

设置参数`inkBarAnimated`、`tabPaneAnimated`控制.en-us: Use `inkBarAnimated` and `tabPaneAnimated` to control tab transitions.

设置参数`type`控制标签页类型。.en-us: Use `type` to choose the tab type.

设置参数`tabBarStyle`控制标签头区域整体样式。.en-us: Use `tabBarStyle` to customize the tab header area.

设置参数`tabBarLeftExtraContent`、`tabBarRigh.en-us: Use `tabBarLeftExtraContent` and `tabBarRightExtraContent` to add content beside the tab controls.

通过参数`placeholder`设置当`items`为空时，取而代之显示的内容.en-us: Use `placeholder` to provide replacement content when `items` is empty.

通过回调函数控制标签页的增删。.en-us: Add and remove tabs through callbacks.

通过回调函数响应标签页标题的右键菜单交互事件。.en-us: Handle tab title context menu interactions through callbacks.
